datasets.name: SBWRTemplatesDSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT T.RowID , T.*
  FROM SBCM_WR_TEMPLATES_new T

datasets.name: SBWRBookmarksDSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT rowid,ID, TEMPLATEID, FIELDID, BOOKMARKNAME
  FROM SBCM_WR_BOOKMARKS_new
where templateid = :templateid

datasets.name: SBWRFieldsDSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT ID, FIELDNAME, DESCRIPTION
  FROM SBCM_WR_FIELDS_new

datasets.name: SBDMInfoDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.id, a.type#, a.opendate, a.closedate, a.amount, a.contractno,
       a.contracttype, a.pledgetype, a.reliabilityid, a.clienttype,
       a.pledgeprice, a.sid#, a.overduereliabilityid, a.branchid,
       a.personaltype, a.currency
  FROM sbcm_contracts_new a
 where id = :conid

datasets.name: SBReplaceDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   B.TEMPLATEID , B.BOOKMARKNAME , A.FIELDNAME
FROM
   SMART.SBCM_WR_BOOKMARKS_new B
 , SMART.SBCM_WR_FIELDS_new A
WHERE
     (B.FIELDID = A.ID)
   AND templateid = :tid
   AND bookmarkname = :bname
